notes.title: Rework of Input System
notes.content:
Reworked the input system so now you can play on either controller or keyboard, Support of rebinding keys coming next. 

W,A,S,D - Move
Arrow Up - Beam
Arrow Down - Shoot
Arrow Left - Hyper
Arrow Right - Bomb
Space - Warp (Hold)

Increased Enemy speed and health, along with reworking on patterns.
